response.overview: Hoping to write a standout story for the school paper, a student convinces three friends—and two of their younger siblings—to explore the abandoned Savani Laboratory. After splitting up to search for clues, the girls uncover an old scientist's journal warning of a dangerous cloning device, just as Jonathan accidentally steps inside the machine and creates an evil twin. Trapped inside the locked building, the group must figure out how to tell the real Jonathan from his sinister clone before it's too late.
response.tagline: While investigating an abandoned laboratory for a school newspaper article, a group of students accidentally activates a malfunctioning cloning machine, unleashing an evil doppelgänger that hunts them through the building.
response.title: Double Trouble
